metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: Authentication — Cross-Site Request Forgery on Auth
properties.description: Detects CSRF attacks targeting authentication endpoints
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'waf' | where RequestMethod == "POST" | where RequestUri has_any ("login", "password", "auth", "changepwd") | where RequestHeaders !contains "X-CSRF" and RequestHeaders !contains "X-Requested-With" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 5
